payload.reason: The evidence clearly states the main aim of the paper, which is to provide a method for annotating parallel error correction data with error type information, facilitating error type evaluation and feedback for non-native learners.

claims.text: The main aim of this paper is to rectify the lack of error type analysis in Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) systems by providing a method for automatic annotation of error types.
The paper also aims to standardize existing datasets under a common error type framework to improve evaluation consistency.
